address.description: Address, landmark or place name to use as the center when the center type is Address. Google resolves it to its own coordinates.
address.title: Address

centerType.description: How the center of the radius is supplied: exact latitude/longitude, a free-text address, or a Google Maps place URL / Place ID.
centerType.title: Search Center Type

excludeCategories.description: Skip places whose category contains any of these words, for example ['hotel', 'casino'].
excludeCategories.title: Exclude Categories

hasPhone.description: Only keep places that publish a phone number on their Google Maps listing.
hasPhone.title: Must Have Phone

hasWebsite.description: Only keep places that publish a website on their Google Maps listing.
hasWebsite.title: Must Have Website

includeClosed.description: When off, places Google marks as permanently closed are skipped. This requires reading each place's preview panel.
includeClosed.title: Include Permanently Closed

includeDetails.description: Add preview-panel fields such as plus code, price level, rating histogram, photos, description, attributes, service options, closing status and hotel/fuel/booking extras. Adds one request per place; listing fields and weekly hours are always collected.
includeDetails.title: Include Place Details

language.description: Language for place names, categories, addresses and hours.
language.title: Language

latitude.description: Latitude of the center when the center type is Coordinates.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Longitude of the center when the center type is Coordinates.
longitude.title: Longitude

maxRating.description: Only keep places rated at or below this value. Places with no published rating are skipped.
maxRating.title: Maximum Rating

maxResults.description: Maximum places to return for each search term. Google's ranked window usually contains roughly 130-180 places inside a dense radius; when the source runs out the run stops honestly instead of padding.
maxResults.title: Max Results per Term

maxReviews.description: Only keep places with at most this many reviews. Places with no review count are skipped.
maxReviews.title: Maximum Review Count

minRating.description: Only keep places rated at or above this value. Places with no published rating are skipped.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

minReviews.description: Only keep places with at least this many reviews. Places with no review count are skipped.
minReviews.title: Minimum Review Count

nameFilter.description: Only keep places whose name contains this text, for example 'pizza'.
nameFilter.title: Name Contains

openNow.description: Only keep places Google currently shows as open. A place whose open/closed state cannot be read is skipped, so this filter can return fewer rows.
openNow.title: Open Now Only

place.description: Google Maps place URL or canonical ChIJ Place ID to use as the center when the center type is Place.
place.title: Place URL or Place ID

radiusKm.description: Hard search radius in kilometres around the center. Places outside it are dropped; every returned row carries its exact distance from the center.
radiusKm.title: Radius (km)

searchTerms.description: One or more categories or free-text keywords, for example ['coffee shop'], ['dentist', 'pharmacy'] or ['restaurant'].
searchTerms.title: Categories / Keywords

title: Google Maps Nearby Radius Search Input
